name: survey_surroundings
description: Survey nearby landmarks plus aligned top-down terrain and relative-height ASCII maps. Full captured region summarized; north up. Use inspect_world for precise interaction or placement checks. Inspect this tool to customize its JavaScript.

focus.description: Comma-separated block ID fragments to prioritize, e.g. chest,furnace.

elevation.description: Select supporting surfaces nearest this absolute feet elevation; defaults to player feet.

includeOres.description: Include ore blocks among landmarks. Default false; mining is handled by target acquisition.
